mapper.select: SELECT IATT_NO, SCATE_ID, SREF_TABLE, IREF_NO, SPATH, SNAME, SMAPPING, SEXT, SMETA, STITLE, SCONTENTS, ISEQ, SINS_DT, ISIZE, SSYS_ID, IDOWN_CNT FROM TB_ATTACH WHERE IATT_NO = #{attNo}

SELECT MAX(OWNER_PROM_NO) FROM ( SELECT v.IPROM_NO AS OWNER_PROM_NO FROM TB_REL_FILE t, TB_REL_VRSN v WHERE t.IATT_NO = #{attNo} AND v.IRVRSN_NO = t.IRVRSN_NO UNION ALL SELECT v.IPROM_NO FROM TB_REL_WORD t, TB_REL_VRSN v WHERE t.IATT_NO = #{attNo} AND v.IRVRSN_NO = t.IRVRSN_NO UNION ALL SELECT v.IPROM_NO FROM TB_REL_ORGN t, TB_REL_VRSN v WHERE t.IATT_NO = #{attNo} AND v.IRVRSN_NO = t.IRVRSN_NO UNION ALL SELECT v.IPROM_NO FROM TB_REL_IMG t, TB_REL_VRSN v WHERE t.IATT_NO = #{attNo} AND v.IRVRSN_NO = t.IRVRSN_NO UNION ALL SELECT v.IPROM_NO FROM TB_ATTACH a, TB_REL_FILE t, TB_REL_VRSN v WHERE a.IATT_NO = #{attNo} AND a.SREF_TABLE = 'TB_REL_FILE' AND t.IRFILE_NO = a.IREF_NO AND v.IRVRSN_NO = t.IRVRSN_NO UNION ALL SELECT v.IPROM_NO FROM TB_ATTACH a, TB_REL_WORD t, TB_REL_VRSN v WHERE a.IATT_NO = #{attNo} AND a.SREF_TABLE = 'TB_REL_WORD' AND t.IRWORD_NO = a.IREF_NO AND v.IRVRSN_NO = t.IRVRSN_NO UNION ALL SELECT v.IPROM_NO FROM TB_ATTACH a, TB_REL_ORGN t, TB_REL_VRSN v WHERE a.IATT_NO = #{attNo} AND a.SREF_TABLE = 'TB_REL_ORGN' AND t.IRORGN_NO = a.IREF_NO AND v.IRVRSN_NO = t.IRVRSN_NO UNION ALL SELECT v.IPROM_NO FROM TB_ATTACH a, TB_REL_IMG t, TB_REL_VRSN v WHERE a.IATT_NO = #{attNo} AND a.SREF_TABLE = 'TB_REL_IMG' AND t.IRIMG_NO = a.IREF_NO AND v.IRVRSN_NO = t.IRVRSN_NO UNION ALL SELECT w.IPROM_NO FROM TB_ATTACH a, TB_PROM_WRK w WHERE a.IATT_NO = #{attNo} AND a.SREF_TABLE = 'TB_PROM_WRK' AND w.IPWRK_NO = a.IREF_NO ) X
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_ATTACH WHERE SREF_TABLE = #{refTable} AND IREF_NO = #{refNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ATTACH SET IDOWN_CNT = COALESCE(IDOWN_CNT, 0) + 1 WHERE IATT_NO = #{attNo}
